title: Jwk
description: The fields in a JSON Web Key.

kty.description: The key type parameter, identifies the cryptographic algorithm family used with the key, such as EC, RSA, oct, OKP or AKP.

use.description: The public key use parameter, identifies the intended use of the public key, either sig or enc.

key_ops.description: The key operations parameter, identifies the operations the key is intended to be used for, such as sign, verify, encrypt, decrypt, wrapKey, unwrapKey, deriveKey or deriveBits.

alg.description: The algorithm parameter, identifies the algorithm intended for use with the key.

kid.description: The key id parameter, used to match a specific key.

x5u.description: The X.509 URL parameter, a URI referring to a resource for an X.509 public key certificate or certificate chain.

x5c.description: The X.509 certificate chain parameter, a chain of one or more base64 encoded PKIX certificates.

x5t.description: The X.509 certificate SHA-1 thumbprint parameter, the base64url encoded SHA-1 digest of the DER encoding of an X.509 certificate.

x5t#S256.description: The X.509 certificate SHA-256 thumbprint parameter, the base64url encoded SHA-256 digest of the DER encoding of an X.509 certificate.

ext.description: Whether the key is extractable, as used by the Web Crypto API.

crv.description: The curve parameter for EC keys, or the subtype of key pair for OKP keys.

x.description: The x coordinate for EC keys, or the public key for OKP keys.

y.description: The y coordinate for EC keys.

d.description: The private exponent for RSA keys, the ECC private key for EC keys, or the private key for OKP keys.

p.description: The first prime factor for private RSA keys.

q.description: The second prime factor for private RSA keys.

dp.description: The first factor CRT exponent for private RSA keys.

dq.description: The second factor CRT exponent for private RSA keys.

qi.description: The first CRT coefficient for private RSA keys.

items.description: The other prime info for a private RSA key.

oth.description: The other primes info parameter for private RSA keys with more than two primes.

k.description: The key value for oct keys.

pub.description: The public key for AKP keys.

priv.description: The private key for AKP keys.

$comment: Additional members are permitted, the JSON Web Key specification allows both registered and private parameter names.
